summary: This XML snippet defines a custom tab element that will be inserted into a UI framework (likely Microsoft Office). The tab is given a unique identifier, positioned after an existing component called 'TabView', and labeled with the text 'Tab' for users to see.

explanations.1: The 'insertAfterMso' attribute tells the system to place this custom tab immediately after a built-in component named 'TabView' rather than at the beginning or end of the tab list.
